transitions.name: create
preconditions: authenticated workspace owns every READY input
idempotency key is new or has the same normalized request digest
postconditions: job and enqueue outbox row exist in one transaction

transitions.name: claim
preconditions: next attempt number is at most three
postconditions: one current attempt has a database-time 60-second lease

transitions.name: duplicate_delivery
preconditions: notification names an existing job that is already active or terminal
postconditions: no attempt or terminal state changes
message may be deleted after the durable observation

transitions.name: heartbeat
postconditions: lease extends from database time by 60 seconds
no lifecycle audit row is required

transitions.name: progress
preconditions: sequence is greater than stored progress sequence
postconditions: bounded current progress snapshot is replaced
terminal and audit state do not change

transitions.name: resolve_cancellation
preconditions: one conditional PostgreSQL update still sees a nonterminal job
postconditions: terminal state and timestamp are immutable

transitions.name: complete
preconditions: artifact object version, digest, and size are verified
one conditional PostgreSQL update still sees running state
postconditions: exact immutable artifact identity becomes authoritative
terminal state and timestamp are immutable

transitions.name: permanent_failure
preconditions: one conditional PostgreSQL update still sees running state

transitions.name: schedule_retry
preconditions: failure is retryable or lease expired
postconditions: retry time uses the delay indexed by completed attempt
retry scheduling and audit rows are transactional

transitions.name: retry_exhausted
preconditions: failure is retryable or lease expired
one conditional PostgreSQL update still sees running state

transitions.name: release_retry
postconditions: enqueue outbox row is created transactionally

transitions.name: reject_stale_attempt
preconditions: attempt number or token is not current
postconditions: progress, artifacts, result, and job state remain unchanged
meaningful stale commit attempts are audited
